title: What auto keeps and drops
description:
`auto` copies by default: it drops `const` and it drops the reference. If you want either, you have to say so.

Fix the three declarations marked below so that each has the type its comment asks for. The tests check the types at compile time.
hints: `auto&` makes a reference, `const auto` makes a constant copy, `const auto&` makes a constant reference.
lessonTitle: auto, Type Deduction and Type Aliases
